en.title: Terkini: is this AI answer still true in Malaysia?
en.meta_description: Terkini checks AI answers about Malaysian rules against official government pages, with exact quotes and a freshness score.
en.tagline: Checks AI answers about Malaysian rules against official government pages. Every verdict carries the exact quote it rests on.
en.cases_intro: Six real runs: a model answered a question, then Terkini checked each claim through Tavily on official sites.
en.own_intro: This page only replays recorded runs: no key, no live calls. To check your own answer, run Terkini on your machine.
en.own_command:
git clone https://github.com/aimanmalib/terkini && cd terkini
uv run terkini check --pack my "Paste the AI answer here"
en.own_copy_failed: Could not copy. The commands are selected: copy them by hand.
en.own_needs: Live checks need your own Tavily key and a Bifrost gateway.
en.load_failed: The recorded run did not load. Reload the page to try again.
en.question: Question
en.summary: {checked} claims checked · {outdated} outdated · {current} current · {unverifiable} not settled
en.as_of_mixed: Reads as if written before {date} (the dates in it are mixed).
en.no_source: No official page settled this claim.
en.legend: Colour shows the verdict on each claim in the answer.
en.not_advice: Not legal advice. Check the linked official source.
en.trace_hint: The Tavily and Bifrost requests behind this run
en.trace_settings_value: topic {topic} · depth {depth}, one retry at {retry} when no official page comes back · max_results {max}
en.trace_depth_unlogged: search_depth not saved in eval runs
en.trace_eval_note: Eval runs saved the credits per claim, not each search. The query is the exact string the checker builds from the claim.
en.trace_fallback_unlogged: fallback not saved in eval runs
en.trace_gateway_total: {calls} gateway calls · {tokens_in} tokens in · {tokens_out} tokens out
en.trace_fallbacks: Fallback order sent with each call
en.trace_spend: Virtual-key spend after the eval run: US${usd}. Bifrost has no price list for these model ids, so token counts are the cost measure.
en.key_note: The answer key was written from official pages before any model answer was seen (docs/EVAL.md).
en.outcome_catch: Terkini got this right: the answer is stale, and the official value Terkini found matches the key.
en.outcome_pass: Terkini got this right: the answer matches the key, and Terkini marked it current.
en.outcome_catch_partial: Right call, weak evidence: the answer is stale (the key says under RM3 million is exempt, not RM20 million). But the official text Terkini quotes is about the 2025 rollout, so its “Official now” line misses the RM3 million exemption.
en.outcome_false_alarm: False alarm, kept on purpose: the answer already gives the current 2% rule and calls RM5 and 11% the old rates. Terkini still marked those old rates outdated. It can misread a claim that the answer puts in the past tense.

ms.title: Terkini: adakah jawapan AI ini masih betul di Malaysia?
ms.meta_description: Terkini menyemak jawapan AI tentang peraturan Malaysia dengan laman rasmi kerajaan, dengan petikan tepat dan skor kesegaran.
ms.tagline: Menyemak jawapan AI tentang peraturan Malaysia dengan laman rasmi kerajaan. Setiap keputusan disertakan petikan tepat yang menjadi asasnya.
ms.cases_intro: Enam larian sebenar: model menjawab soalan, kemudian Terkini menyemak setiap dakwaan melalui Tavily di laman rasmi.
ms.own_intro: Halaman ini hanya memainkan semula larian yang dirakam: tiada kunci, tiada panggilan langsung. Untuk menyemak jawapan anda sendiri, jalankan Terkini di komputer anda.
ms.own_command:
git clone https://github.com/aimanmalib/terkini && cd terkini
uv run terkini check --pack my "Tampal jawapan AI di sini"
ms.own_copy_failed: Tidak dapat menyalin. Arahan sudah dipilih: salin secara manual.
ms.own_needs: Semakan langsung memerlukan kunci Tavily dan gerbang Bifrost anda sendiri.
ms.load_failed: Larian yang dirakam gagal dimuatkan. Muat semula halaman untuk cuba lagi.
ms.question: Soalan
ms.summary: {checked} dakwaan disemak · {outdated} lapuk · {current} semasa · {unverifiable} tidak dapat dipastikan
ms.as_of_mixed: Kedengaran seperti ditulis sebelum {date} (tarikh di dalamnya bercampur).
ms.no_source: Tiada laman rasmi yang memutuskan dakwaan ini.
ms.legend: Warna menunjukkan keputusan bagi setiap dakwaan dalam jawapan.
ms.not_advice: Bukan nasihat undang-undang. Semak sumber rasmi yang dipautkan.
ms.trace_hint: Permintaan Tavily dan Bifrost di sebalik larian ini
ms.trace_settings_value: topic {topic} · kedalaman {depth}, satu cubaan semula pada {retry} bila tiada halaman rasmi · max_results {max}
ms.trace_depth_unlogged: search_depth tidak disimpan dalam larian eval
ms.trace_eval_note: Larian eval menyimpan kredit bagi setiap dakwaan, bukan setiap carian. Pertanyaan ialah rentetan tepat yang dibina penyemak daripada dakwaan.
ms.trace_fallback_unlogged: fallback tidak disimpan dalam larian eval
ms.trace_gateway_total: {calls} panggilan gerbang · {tokens_in} token masuk · {tokens_out} token keluar
ms.trace_fallbacks: Susunan fallback yang dihantar bersama setiap panggilan
ms.trace_spend: Perbelanjaan kunci maya selepas larian eval: US${usd}. Bifrost tiada senarai harga untuk id model ini, jadi kiraan token ialah ukuran kos.
ms.key_note: Kunci jawapan ditulis dari halaman rasmi sebelum mana-mana jawapan model dilihat (docs/EVAL.md).
ms.outcome_catch: Terkini betul di sini: jawapan itu lapuk, dan nilai rasmi yang Terkini jumpa sama dengan kunci.
ms.outcome_pass: Terkini betul di sini: jawapan sama dengan kunci, dan Terkini menandanya semasa.
ms.outcome_catch_partial: Keputusan betul, bukti lemah: jawapan itu lapuk (kunci kata bawah RM3 juta dikecualikan, bukan RM20 juta). Tetapi teks rasmi yang Terkini petik ialah tentang pelaksanaan 2025, jadi baris “Rasmi sekarang” tidak menyebut pengecualian RM3 juta.
ms.outcome_false_alarm: Amaran palsu, sengaja dikekalkan: jawapan sudah memberi peraturan 2% semasa dan menyebut RM5 dan 11% sebagai kadar lama. Terkini tetap menanda kadar lama itu lapuk. Ia boleh tersalah baca dakwaan yang jawapan letak dalam kala lampau.
